google_analytics_measurement_id.description: Control Panel normalizes accepted GA4 IDs to uppercase and clears the value when analytics is disabled.

smtp_password.description: Write-only SMTP password. It is encrypted at rest and never returned by API, UI, logs, or audit metadata.

turnstile_secret.description: Write-only Turnstile secret. It is never returned by API, UI, logs, or audit metadata.

ControlNotificationChannelCreateRequest.description: Control Panel notification-channel creation. Email channels always use globally managed application SMTP settings, enforced by the backend. Per-channel SMTP fields and uses_global_smtp are not accepted.

ControlNotificationChannelUpdateRequest.description: Control Panel notification-channel update. Per-channel SMTP fields and uses_global_smtp are not accepted. migrate_to_global_smtp is the only supported delivery-mode transition; true migrates an existing legacy email channel to globally managed application SMTP, while omission or false preserves the current mode. Omitting email_recipients preserves the existing masked recipient set.

email_recipients.description: Optional replacement recipient set. Omission preserves existing recipients; an explicitly empty array is invalid.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are rejected.

migrate_to_global_smtp.description: Set true to migrate an existing legacy email channel from per-channel SMTP to globally managed application SMTP. Omission or false preserves the current delivery mode; this request flag is never returned.

webhook_url.description: Optional write-only webhook replacement. Omission preserves the existing encrypted URL; it is never returned raw.

reconnect_base_delay.description: Go duration string for the initial voice rejoin backoff, for example 2s.

reconnect_max_delay.description: Go duration string for the maximum voice rejoin backoff, for example 30s.

service_id.description: Discord Bot service allowed to receive this config through runtime config.

bot_token.description: Write-only Discord Bot token. Never returned by Control API, UI, logs, or audit metadata.

reconnect_base_delay.description: Go duration string for the initial voice rejoin backoff, for example 2s.

reconnect_max_delay.description: Go duration string for the maximum voice rejoin backoff, for example 30s.

last_error.description: Stable, secret-safe delivery state code; raw Bot errors are not exposed.

lifecycle_status.description: Provider status when known; stream_key uses legacy_unverified by explicit compatibility policy.

recovery_of_id.description: Prior delivery_unknown record acknowledged by an operator.

watch_url.description: Canonical public YouTube watch URL; no RTMP URL or stream key is included.

acknowledge_possible_duplicate.description: Explicit operator attestation that the original request may already have posted to Discord.

folder_id.description: required when creating a destination, optional when updating an existing destination, encrypted at rest, and never returned by API

EncoderOutputRelayCapabilities.description: Non-secret service capability hints for output relay routing and negotiated Worker scene-video transport.

output_relay_binding_id.description: Required with live_api_static. Non-secret fixed relay binding identity that must match the selected live_api_relay_static output; never an RTMPS address or stream key.

scene_frames_mjpeg_srt.description: Worker can render the complete scene as low-rate MJPEG images over the negotiated job-scoped SRT ingest without video encoding.

scene_video_srt.description: Legacy Worker H.264 MPEG-TS capability accepted for migration reads only.

worker_frame_ingest_mjpeg_srt.description: Encoder/Recorder can receive Worker-rendered JPEG images, hold the latest frame, and perform the only video encode and audio mux.

worker_video_ingest_srt.description: Legacy Encoder H.264 MPEG-TS capability accepted for migration reads only.

EncoderOutputRelayMode.description: Non-secret Encoder/Recorder output relay routing vocabulary. New Encoder reports use the canonical direct, legacy_stream_key, or live_api_static values. direct has no fixed output relay; legacy_stream_key means a fixed relay uses a preconfigured legacy YouTube stream-key route; and live_api_static means a fixed relay accepts the non-secret live API static binding. The historical static value is accepted on Control Panel capability input and registered-service reads for migration compatibility with legacy_stream_key semantics. Unknown values are rejected fail closed. This value never carries an RTMPS URL, relay URL, or stream key.

code.description: Stable, secret-safe Control API error or readiness issue code. Start-readiness checks are side-effect-free and do not read or return raw secrets.

readiness.description: Secret-safe external verification readiness summary. Missing lists contain field names, service types, or capability names only.

runtime_config.description: Control Panel-managed runtime config IDs only. Raw Discord channel IDs, Drive folder IDs, OAuth tokens, RTMPS URLs, stream keys, and session cookies are never returned.

schema_version.description: Version of the non-secret external verification confirmation export schema.

service_assignments.description: Assigned service IDs only. Service token binding IDs and raw service tokens are never returned.

HostAgentPolicyRequest.description: Server-owned transport, execution_host_id, and ownership_epoch fields are never accepted from this request.

local_executor_policy_revision.description: Zero is allowed only for an observe-only epoch-zero policy with no policy digest.

ownership_epoch.description: Server-owned monotonic fencing epoch. Zero is the observe-only, not-yet-owned sentinel and is never valid for mutation.

revision.description: Projection cursor for this host-agent policy.

HostSelfUpdate.description: Dedicated lifecycle; it is never represented as a generic update job.

HostSelfUpdateCreateRequest.description: The host binding comes only from the path. Release commit, artifact, digest, location, and credentials are resolved by the server.

HostSelfUpdateRelease.description: Verified immutable public release identity. No download location or credential is persisted or returned.

ManagedAppSettings.description: Administrator application settings. Secret values are represented only by configured status.

turnstile_configured.description: Configured status only. The Turnstile secret is never returned.

masked_email_target.description: Raw email recipients and SMTP settings are never returned as unmasked response fields.

masked_webhook_url.description: Raw webhook URL is never returned.

smtp_password_configured.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility status. False for global-SMTP channels and never exposes the password.

uses_global_smtp.description: Whether this email channel delegates delivery to Control Panel using globally managed application SMTP settings. This reveals no SMTP credentials.

error.description: Optional sanitized error. Raw provider responses, target URLs, credentials, and tokens are never returned.

target.description: Masked delivery target only. Raw webhook URLs and email recipient addresses are never returned.

access_token_refresh_failure_code.description: Bounded non-secret operational failure class. Provider response bodies, error descriptions, and tokens are never returned.

access_token_refresh_relink_required.description: True only when the recorded automatic refresh failure requires reconnecting this existing OAuth account; reconnecting retains the account ID and its references.

access_token_refreshed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the short-lived OAuth access token was last refreshed automatically; the access token itself is never returned or persisted

refresh_token_updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the stored OAuth refresh token was first registered or replaced; legacy accounts without recorded history return an empty string

token_fingerprint.description: short fingerprint for change tracking, not a secret value

provider_id.description: optional explicit provider id; must match state when supplied

account_label.description: optional operator label; callback may derive a label from the verified email

account_purpose.description: Optional requested connected-account capability. Canonical values are drive, youtube, and drive_youtube; documented compatibility aliases are accepted and normalized by the Control Panel.

oauth_account_id.description: Existing connected-account ID to re-link. The server derives provider_id when it is omitted.

provider_id.description: OAuth provider configured in the Integration Registry

redirect_after.description: safe local path to redirect to after browser callback

account_label.description: Operator-facing label. Provider identity, scopes, and refresh token remain immutable outside OAuth callback.

redirect_after.description: same-site relative path to return to after login

state.description: one-time OAuth state token; stored hashed server-side

auto_provision.description: Enable first-login user creation for allowed OAuth identities.

client_secret.description: encrypted at rest; never returned by API

default_role_ids.description: Required when auto_provision is true. Server requires roles.assign for this field.

redirect_uri.description: Must match AUTOSTREAM_PUBLIC_URL scheme/host in production.

OAuthUserLinkWriteRequest.description:
Legacy administrative shape. Production links must be created through
the OAuth callback ceremony; manual subject entry is disabled by the
Control Panel and returns manual_oauth_link_disabled.

PasskeyCredential.description: Public WebAuthn credential metadata. Raw credential ID and public key material are never returned.

username.description: Optional username hint. Empty requests create a discoverable login challenge without enumerating users.

challenge_token.description: Short-lived one-time token returned only to the browser starting the login ceremony.

registration_token.description: Short-lived one-time token returned only to the current authenticated user.

config.description: Secret references may be present, but raw secret values must not be returned.

PublicAppSettings.description: Public browser bootstrap settings. SMTP and all secret values are excluded.

google_analytics_measurement_id.description: Public GA4 measurement ID, present only when analytics is enabled and valid.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name used by the Control Panel UI.

turnstile_configured.description: Configured status only. The Turnstile secret is never returned.

assignment_role.description: present only when returned as a stream assignment. Only primary services receive dispatch; standby services are failover candidates and cannot resolve stream-scoped runtime secrets until promoted.

execution_host_id.description: Stable execution-host identity owned by a pull_v2 update agent.

ownership_epoch.description: Server-owned execution-host ownership epoch. Zero is the observe-only, not-yet-owned sentinel.

transport_mode.description: Existing payloads that omit transport_mode are interpreted as ssh_v1. An update_agent with transport_mode pull_v2 must omit host, port, and public_url.

mfa_required_roles.description: Empty means an enabled mfa_mode applies to all users. Otherwise only users with one of these roles must complete that MFA policy.

passkey_status.description: available means WebAuthn registration, passwordless login, and passkey-required login policy are available.

archive_run_id.description: Stable identifier for one broadcast/archive run of the stream.

archive_started_at.description: Start timestamp of the archive run.

assignment_role.description: primary is dispatched on stream start; standby is registered as a failover candidate but is not started automatically.

html.description: Optional HTML alternative. The server enforces a maximum of 65,536 UTF-8 bytes and rejects NUL; callers must keep text as the plain-text fallback.

recipients.description: Email envelope recipients. Responses and errors never reflect these addresses raw.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are rejected.

subject.description: Email subject. The server counts Unicode code points and rejects CR/LF to prevent header injection.

text.description: Plain-text body. The server enforces a maximum of 16,384 UTF-8 bytes and rejects NUL.

recipient_count.description: Number of recipients submitted without returning their addresses.

ServiceObservabilitySignal.description: service_id and service_type, if supplied by the caller, are ignored and replaced with the authenticated registered service identity.

public_url.description: Control Panel から到達可能な http/https absolute URL。

expires_in_sec.description: Lease lifetime for this resolved value. During this window, the same service/context/secret returns runtime_secret_lease_active instead of the raw value.

service_id.description: Optional service ID to pre-create as a pending registry entry. Requires service.register scope.

absolute_expires_at.description: Hard session expiry. Activity refresh never moves this timestamp.

assignments.description: Public registered service summaries. Service token binding IDs and raw tokens are never returned.

primary_service_count.description: Number of primary assignments eligible for start dispatch. Standby assignments are listed but excluded until promoted.

discord_config_id.description: Discord Bot Config selected for this stream. Required before stream-specific guild/channel overrides can be used. Control Panel resolves guild/channel server-side and verifies it matches the assigned primary Discord Bot service.

discord_guild_id.description: Stream-specific Discord guild ID override. Valid only with discord_config_id. If omitted, the selected Discord Config default is used.

discord_text_channel_id.description: Optional stream-specific Discord text channel ID override. Valid only with discord_config_id. If omitted, the selected Discord Config default is used.

discord_voice_channel_id.description: Stream-specific Discord voice channel ID override. Valid only with discord_config_id. If omitted, the selected Discord Config default is used.

url.description: Signed index.m3u8 URL or same-origin path. The web client resolves a same-origin path before copying it to an external player. It expires after 12 hours at most and is invalidated when the stream stops.

port_plan_sha256.description: In a job or claim this authenticates the stable server-derived intent.

expected_source_policy_revision.description: Source policy revision used only for derivation/audit compare-and-swap.

projection_revision.description: Canonical ownership, job, and mutation-grant policy fence.

source_policy_revision.description: Source policy revision retained for derivation and audit.

expected_projection_revision.description: Pull projection revision currently fencing ownership, jobs, and mutation grants.

expected_source_policy_revision.description: Source pull-policy revision used for compare-and-swap and audit.

source_policy_revision.description: Source pull-policy revision retained for observer operation and future reactivation.

eligible_operations.description: Operations currently eligible for this target. Legacy eligible and blocked_reason continue to describe software_update.

operation_blocked_reasons.description: Stable blocked-reason codes keyed by operation when that operation is not eligible.

host_id.description: Optional execution-host identity. It is required for central multi-host operation; omission retains legacy per-host updater behavior.

active_job_id.description: Optional locally active job. When present, the server returns only that job's renewed lease or an explicit clear_active_job_id response; it never claims a different job.

host_id.description: Optional execution-host identity. It is required for central multi-host operation; omission retains legacy per-host updater behavior.
